headline: Freshworks, a business software company, has agreed to buy Torii, which tracks what companies spend on software and AI tools.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: the deal was announced 12 Oct, before the 14 Oct window.
importance_line: IT and finance teams get one view of software and AI costs, but the deal has not closed and no price was given in the report.
summary: Indian Startup News reports that Freshworks, a Nasdaq-listed maker of business software, signed an agreement on 12 Oct 2026 to buy Torii, a platform that tracks what companies spend on software and AI tools, with the deal due to close in the fourth quarter of Freshworks' fiscal 2026. The report does not give a price, and Freshworks says the aim is to help IT and finance teams see AI costs that vary with use.
